name: Drawer
description: Responsive Base UI Drawer with four edges, configurable snap points, nested panels and non-modal interaction.

figma.notes: Based on the cart observed on 2026-10-13. No independent Figma binding assigned.

finalFocus.description: Override the return target on dismissal.

description.description: Optional supporting copy below the title, inside the fixed header above its divider. Linked with aria-describedby. Omission preserves the original header.

titleContent.description: Custom visual title. The required title string remains the accessible name of the dialog.

onAfterClose.description: Runs after exit releases the modal, for focus fallback when the original opener no longer exists.

size.description: Mobile starts at content, full (default), or half height. Half can snap to full. Desktop fills the right edge.

swipeDirection.description: Defaults to right on desktop and down on mobile.

showSwipeHandle.description: Show a drag handle. Defaults on for drawers with snap points.

snapPoints.description: Ascending vertical stops in viewport fractions, pixels or rem.

contentPadding.description: Spacing of the independently scrolling body.

footer.description: Host-owned actions outside the scrolling content.

back.description: Child view navigation; Escape returns to the parent.

focus.note: Uses shared focus aliases and native keyboard behavior.

radius.note: Semantic radii; a desktop edge-attached Drawer has square corners.

accessibility.ariaPattern: Named dialog with optional modal isolation and vertical height slider

testing.rationale: Storybook covers child-view navigation. Browser tests cover touch snap points, keyboard resizing, footer geometry, focus restoration and reduced motion.
